name: Fantastic.jobs
summary: A job-postings feed from 58 ATS platforms and LinkedIn, Wellfound and Y Combinator, with AI-derived salary, seniority and remote fields and company details.

api_key.description: A Fantastic.jobs API key (dashboard.fantastic.jobs), sent as a Bearer token.

notes: Two meters: Jobs credits, one per job returned by active-ats and active-jb; and API Requests, one per call on every endpoint. Modified, expired and organization endpoints use no Jobs credits. x-api-jobs-* and x-api-requests-* headers show usage.
Built for polling into your own store: time_frame 1h or 24h on a schedule, expired-ats to drop stale rows. Jobs appear 1-2 hours after the source publishes them.
Use a count endpoint to size a query before pulling it, since every returned job costs a credit.
This is the data.fantastic.jobs v1 API; the older api.fantastic.jobs and marketplace listings use other parameter and field names.

endpoints.name: Get ATS jobs
endpoints.summary: Active jobs from company career sites (Greenhouse, Lever, Workday, Ashby and 54 more), filtered by title, location, organization and AI fields.

cursor.description: The last job's id, for cursor paging (orders by id ascending; use for 6m).

description_format.description: text or html; omit to leave descriptions out.

title.description: Title search, Google-style: words AND, "exact phrase", OR, -exclude.

description.description: Search title and description together; same syntax as title.

location.description: Location search with full names (United States, not US; 'New York, United States').

date_posted_gte.description: Posted on or after, ISO 8601 UTC, e.g. 2026-04-20T00:00:00.

date_created_gte.description: Indexed on or after, ISO 8601 UTC; use for incremental syncs.

ai_work_arrangement.description: Comma-separated: On-site, Hybrid, Remote OK, Remote Solely.

has_salary.description: true: only jobs with salary data.

include_basic_organization_details.description: true adds LinkedIn company fields to each job.

notes: One Jobs credit per job returned.

cursor.description: The last job's id, for cursor paging (orders by id ascending; use for 6m).

date_posted_gte.description: Posted on or after, ISO 8601 UTC, e.g. 2026-04-20T00:00:00.

date_created_gte.description: Indexed on or after, ISO 8601 UTC; use for incremental syncs.

ai_work_arrangement.description: Comma-separated: On-site, Hybrid, Remote OK, Remote Solely.

time_frame.description: Window; 1m (default) also counts jobs that have since expired.

endpoints.name: Get modified ATS jobs
endpoints.summary: ATS jobs whose tracked fields changed in the last 24 hours, with date_modified and modified_fields.

cursor.description: The last job's id, for cursor paging (orders by id ascending; use for 6m).

description_format.description: text or html; omit to leave descriptions out.

notes: Pro plan. No Jobs credits. Call once a day at a fixed time.

endpoints.name: Get expired ATS job ids
endpoints.summary: Ids of ATS jobs that expired in the window, to remove from a stored copy.

endpoints.name: Get company details
